issues.analysis: ADR-0064 says the predicate scans the Blueprint's Skill-Coverage Decisions section; ADR-0065 says the section is embedded in synthesis.md and explicitly forbids embedding in the Blueprint. These two new ADRs were authored in the same run by the same composer and they contradict each other on a load-bearing implementation detail. The predicate's source-of-truth path is undefined — implementers will pick one or the other and the dogfood signal becomes ambiguous. ADR-0065's rationale strand 4 references ADR-0064 Clause 3 explicitly, indicating the contradiction is editorial drift rather than intentional divergence.
issues.recommended_resolution: Patch ADR-0064 Clause 3 (line 82) to read 'scanning the synthesis.md Skill-Coverage Decisions section' so it aligns with ADR-0065 Clause 1 (the load-bearing artifact-location decision). Optionally also update ADR-0064 Options Considered Option B (line 117) which has the same wording. This is an in-place edit per ADR-0005 (the contradiction is editorial, not a substantive supersession event).

issues.summary: ADR-0065 cites a shared-document-reviewer invocation point that does not exist in ADR-0017

evidence.quote: Substance review (`shared-document-reviewer` invocation 2 on `synthesis.md`) is the human's responsibility for (a) and (c).
ADR-0017 — `shared-document-reviewer` invocation 2 reviews `synthesis.md`
Invocation 2 — After PRD generation: shared-document-reviewer invoked with doc_type: PRD. Verdict feeds into PRD Approval Gate.
None of the 5 invocation points review synthesis.md

issues.analysis: ADR-0065 places the FR-7 substance review for (a) existing-skill and (c) no-skill-warranted rows on 'shared-document-reviewer invocation 2 on synthesis.md'. ADR-0017 — which ADR-0065 inherits in its frontmatter (adrs_inherited: ADR-0017 v1.0.0) — defines exactly 5 invocation points: Intent Clarification, PRD, Blueprint (DesignDoc), Plan, ADR. Synthesis is NOT a reviewed document under ADR-0017. Invocation 2 specifically reviews the PRD. ADR-0065's contract for substance review therefore has no actual reviewer assigned: the named invocation does not exist, and no other ADR-0017 invocation reads synthesis.md. The FR-7 substance heuristic for (a) and (c) rows has nowhere to fire.
issues.recommended_resolution: Three resolution paths; design-composer should pick one and patch ADR-0065 in-place per ADR-0005 (editorial correction, not supersession): (1) Reassign substance review to invocation 3 (Blueprint review) — the design-composer reads synthesis.md when composing the Blueprint and can cross-validate (a)/(c) substance there, but the reviewer-side check would be at Blueprint review; (2) Extend ADR-0017's invocation list with a new sixth point (synthesis.md review) — heavier change, requires superseding ADR-0017; (3) Move FR-7 substance review responsibility to design-composer's Blueprint composition substance check (currently implicit), making explicit the composer-as-reviewer pattern. Path (1) is lowest-cost and consistent with the Blueprint's actual data flow.

issues.summary: ADR-0065 Clause 3 mandates dogfood synthesis.md embedded section in this run, but synthesis.md does not contain a Skill-Coverage Decisions section

evidence.quote: Per Clause 1, the embedded section is authored in this run's synthesis.md with one decision row per concept, each resolving per the per-concept rationale in the Blueprint's Eat-Own-Dogfood section.

grep 'Skill-Coverage Decisions' synthesis.md → only references to the concept in narrative prose (lines 72, 76, 88, 118, 157); no embedded section header '## Skill-Coverage Decisions' with the 6 dogfood rows in template form.

R2a applies its own contracts to itself: this run produces an agent-roster-impact-matrix.md (per ADR-0064) and six skill-coverage decisions (per ADR-0065) at Plan / Task-Decomposition time, validating the contracts before they're imposed on future authors.
Six FR-7 skill-coverage decisions embedded in working/feature/pipeline-design-time-discipline-r1/synthesis.md (per ADR-0065).

issues.analysis: The Blueprint contains the six skill-coverage decisions inline (Blueprint table lines 343-352), but ADR-0065 Clause 1 explicitly forbids the Blueprint as the embedding location ('not in the Blueprint'). The Blueprint then claims at line 341 that the six decisions are embedded in synthesis.md, but synthesis.md has no Skill-Coverage Decisions section in template form. The Blueprint also says at line 45 the dogfood deliverable lands 'at Plan / Task-Decomposition time' — deferring the obligation to a downstream stage. The combination is: (a) the Blueprint claims dogfood happens in synthesis.md, (b) the Blueprint itself embeds the table where ADR-0065 forbids, (c) the actual synthesis.md does not contain the section, (d) the Blueprint also defers the obligation to Plan time. This is the exact failure shape R2a is designed to prevent: a discipline that has somewhere to live but does not actually live there yet. Cross-references back to ADR-0065 Clause 3 imply the discipline should be observable in this run before downstream consumers can rely on it.
issues.recommended_resolution: Two paths: (1) Author the actual Skill-Coverage Decisions section in synthesis.md now (back-fill into the synthesis document; the synth-synthesizer agent is the canonical author per ADR-0065 line 138). The Blueprint table at lines 343-352 becomes the source content. This is the strictest dogfood interpretation. (2) Explicitly note in the Blueprint that the synthesis.md back-fill is a Plan-stage Phase G task — and pre-position the Blueprint table as a Plan-stage input. Path (1) is structurally cleaner because it makes the dogfood signal observable at Blueprint review time. The current state — Blueprint contains the table, synthesis.md does not — is the in-between state that produces an ambiguous dogfood signal.

issues.summary: FR-1's design-realization audit would catch I-AA-001, I-AA-002, I-AA-003, I-AA-004 if FR-1 already existed

evidence.quote: R2a ships the design-time-discipline half of the parent run's split — six PRD mechanisms (FR-1, FR-6, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10) that move per-agent design evaluation and ADR design-realization audit from aspiration to structural prevention.
Eat-own-dogfood validation — at packaging time, the SA-14 audit fires against this run's own working directory.
The contract is dogfooded on its own run

issues.analysis: Pedagogical observation, not a defect-class finding. I-AA-001 (ADR-0064 vs ADR-0065 location contradiction) is exactly the shape of cross-artifact-relationship defect FR-1's design-realization audit catches between an ADR and the artifact it prescribes. I-AA-002 (ADR-0065 citing a non-existent ADR-0017 invocation point) is the shape of decision-vs-inherited-ADR contradiction the brief-honor lens catches. I-AA-003 (20 vs 24 KB-review-disciplines consumers) is the shape of consumer-count drift FR-10's SA-14 backstop catches in matrix form. I-AA-004 (synthesis.md vs Blueprint embedding mismatch) is the shape FR-7 + FR-1 jointly catch. This audit run has demonstrated, on the very Blueprint that defines these mechanisms, that the mechanisms catch defects this audit reviewer just caught manually. The dogfood signal is strong: R2a's mechanisms would have caught R2a's own defects had they been in place. Recommend recording this observation in the run summary or deliverable archive as the dogfood validation event the Blueprint refers to.
issues.recommended_resolution: No code change required. Recommend the orchestrator or finalize-deliverable-packager surface this finding in the pipeline run summary as the dogfood validation evidence per Blueprint §Risks line 419 ('applying the contract to its own definer is the validation event').

verdict_rationale: Zero BLOCKER findings — the Blueprint's architectural shape is sound: brief-honor is solid, inherited ADRs are cited not relitigated, blast-radius is well-mapped, the new ADRs are coherent in their decision substance, and the eat-own-dogfood discipline is committed. Four MAJOR findings concentrate on consistency between the two new sibling ADRs (I-AA-001 location contradiction; I-AA-002 invocation-point reference error) and on dogfood-signal completeness (I-AA-003 bridge consumer count drift; I-AA-004 synthesis.md back-fill gap). All four MAJOR findings are editorial / metadata corrections — not architectural redesign. Recommend finalize-reconciler dispatch revision for I-AA-001..I-AA-004 with in-place edits per ADR-0005 (none rise to supersession threshold). MINOR I-AA-005 and I-AA-006 can ride along in the same revision pass or land at Plan stage. INFO I-AA-007 is pedagogical — no edit, but surface to user as dogfood validation evidence.
